period: Classical mythic ancient Greece; production design rather than archaeological reconstruction.

locations.name: Troy
locations.production_lock: Warm sandy limestone walls, square gate towers, broad wooden double gate, honey-brown wheeled horse; day construction, sunset entry, moonlit escape.

locations.name: Greek ship
locations.production_lock: Red-brown timber hull, single mast and cream square sail, paired oars, raised curved prow and stern; same intact vessel until Chapter8.

locations.name: Cyclops island
locations.production_lock: Pale rocky island, broad warm-rock cave, giant round boulder at doorway, white sheep and cheese baskets; no modern doors.

locations.name: Aeolus island
locations.production_lock: Sunny terrace above turquoise sea; tied brown leather wind bag only contains winds, not gold.

locations.name: Circe island
locations.production_lock: Lush forest-green island, forest-green stone house, ochre-red roof, wood table and golden cup; leafy path where Hermes appears.

locations.name: Land of shadows
locations.production_lock: Still blue-gray shore, mist, reeds and muted horizon; gentle luminous spirits, no horror props.

locations.name: Siren rocks
locations.production_lock: Low isolated rocky islet beside hazardous rocks; ship safely passes at a distance, Sirens remain ashore.

locations.name: Sea-monster strait
locations.production_lock: Scylla cliff to viewer left and single immense whirlpool to right; ship must pass cliff side, no spatial reversal in same sequence.

locations.name: Sun god island
locations.production_lock: Sunny green meadow with golden-brown cattle, then windbound shore and hungry camp, followed by sea storm.

locations.name: Calypso island
locations.production_lock: Lush sheltered cove, small coastal shelter, turquoise water, warm quiet light; new small boat at departure.

locations.name: Ithaca home
locations.production_lock: Cream-stone palace, terracotta roof, olive grove and sheltered blue bay; hall cream columns/wood beams; bedroom bed built around rooted olive tree.
